system.name: Neo
system.one_liner: a hardware accelerator for real-time on-device 3D Gaussian Splatting using reuse-and-update sorting

components.name: Sorting Core 1..16
components.role: 16 parallel cores composing the Sorting Engine, one of which is expanded in detail

components.name: Bitonic Sorting Unit (BSU)
components.role: performs bitonic sorting within a Sorting Core

components.name: Input Buffer
components.role: holds incoming Gaussian data for the Sorting Core

components.name: Output Buffer
components.role: holds sorted Gaussian data output from the Sorting Core

components.name: Merge Sorting Unit+ (MSU+)
components.role: merges two locally sorted lists using invalid-bit filtering to complete dynamic partial sorting

components.name: Index Counter
components.role: tracks the current read index across the two local input buffers during merge

components.name: Local Input buffer 1
components.role: holds one of the two locally sorted sequences being merged

components.name: Local Input buffer 2
components.role: holds the other locally sorted sequence being merged

components.name: Invalid Bit Filter
components.role: filters out entries flagged invalid (e.g., outgoing Gaussians) during the merge

components.name: Local Output buffer
components.role: receives the merged, filtered output sequence

content.key_idea: Each of Neo's 16 parallel Sorting Cores combines a Bitonic Sorting Unit for local sorting with an enhanced Merge Sorting Unit+ that merges two sorted sequences while filtering out invalid (outgoing) entries via per-entry invalid bits, avoiding a full re-sort.

summary: This figure details Neo's Sorting Engine microarchitecture. At the top, the Sorting Engine is shown as 16 parallel Sorting Cores; one core is expanded to reveal a Bitonic Sorting Unit (BSU) alongside Input and Output Buffers and a Merge Sorting Unit+ (MSU+). The bottom panel further expands the MSU+, Neo's key novel component: it holds two locally sorted sequences in separate local input buffers, tracks progress with an index counter, applies an invalid-bit filter to each buffer to drop outgoing (no-longer-visible) Gaussians, and merges the filtered streams through a comparator/multiplexer into a local output buffer. The figure conveys how reuse-and-update sorting is implemented at the hardware level by augmenting a standard bitonic/merge sort pipeline with invalid-entry filtering.
summary_zh: 该图展示Neo排序引擎的微架构：排序引擎由16个并行排序核心组成，每个核心含位序排序单元(BSU)、输入输出缓冲区和增强型归并排序单元(MSU+)；下方进一步展开MSU+内部结构，通过索引计数器、双本地输入缓冲区、无效位过滤器和比较器/多路复用器，实现对失效高斯的过滤与归并，支撑复用-更新式排序。
